acceptance_tests.description: Initialize all contracts & deploy to specified chain (localnet/devnet)
steps: Set env.CHAIN to localnet or devnet
Verify all required programs are deployed: Vault + Note/Receipt + Adapter
Verify init instructions executed (vault state accounts exist)

acceptance_tests.description: Airdrop env.DEPLOYER 5 SOL and supply 4 SOL into Vault
steps: Assert env.DEPLOYER balance decreased by ~4 SOL + fees
Assert vault SOL balance increased by 4 SOL

acceptance_tests.description: Create project USDC mint and mint 10^6 USDC into Vault
steps: Create vault token account for USDC
Mint 1,000,000 USDC to the vault token account
Assert vault USDC token account balance == 1,000,000

acceptance_tests.description: After bootstrap, Vault has 4 SOL + 10^6 USDC
steps: Query vault USDC token account balance

acceptance_tests.description: Airdrop env.PUBLIC_WALLET 2 SOL
steps: Assert env.PUBLIC_WALLET balance == 2 SOL (minus possible fees if used)

acceptance_tests.description: Each wallet has exactly one active note string; seed rule uses timestamp + walletAddress + lastTxnId
steps: Perform SECURE Supply; capture new note
Assert only one note is marked active in LOCAL_STORAGE for wallet A
Assert note seed inputs reflect (timestamp, walletAddress=A, lastTxnId=txid from previous action)
Assert note string format is veil-note-v1:<hex>

acceptance_tests.description: Save note to storage copies note string and stores access record for cross-wallet import
steps: Perform a SECURE action that produces a new note
Verify clipboard contains the note string
Verify localStorage has veillend.note_access:{noteHash} with lastTxnId, privacyNotes, and secrets
Paste the note string in Import Existing Note on another wallet (with access record pre-synced)
Verify position appears for new wallet

acceptance_tests.description: Aggregated positions derive from verified notes (supply/borrow totals)
steps: Create multiple SECURE actions to generate multiple notes
Verify aggregation uses verified note/proof state (not wallet balances)
Import note string with a pre-synced access record containing multiple notes
Verify Portfolio totals reflect aggregated borrow/supply
